remarks: Sparkling, bright and totally updated colonial split level in the sought after Mid Ridges. Convenient to I 95, the Merritt, public transportation, shopping, dining and library. Newer eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite counters. Large deck off of the kitchen to enjoy grilling and summer dining, Vaulted ceiling in the living room with fireplace and dining room. Master bedroom has an updated bath. Family room, den/office and half bath on the first level. All with hardwood floors. Finished basement has a playroom, laundry, and storage, all with tile floors. Furnace with NEST thermostat. Pet friendly.
